data.name: The Lost Wizard
data.detailed_description:
Enter the magical castle of The Lost Wizard,you are tibiothar a skilled wizard, the castle was attacked by the evil skeleton king, free the magician Althazar from the tyranny of skeleton king and bring peace inside the castle of Althazar, destroy the army of darkness. Your actions will be remembered forever.
Face ten fantastic dungeons, collect gems to evolve Tibiothar, learn magic through magical books, stop the army of skeleton king. The Lost Wizard is an adventure RPG puzzle game. You will have to think well before making a move. The evolution of the character lies in the collection of gems, when you collect all the gems Tibiothar will have reached the maximum level of magic. When you feel ready you will face skeleton king.

Story :
skeleton has invaded the castle of althazar, where once peace reigned and evil was under the control of the wizards guild. althazar was imprisoned, tibiothar and survivor of the attack, they are a skilled wizard and can still save his master.
But during the tibiothar adventure, you will have to learn more powerful spells to face the ultimate battle.

Key Feauteres :

■ Ten fantastic dungeons await you

■ Evolve your character

■ Learn more and more powerful spells

■ Use the spirit of fire to interact with the environment

■ Collect the gems of power

■ Free the magician Althazar

■ Kill king skeleton

■ Brings peace in the walls of the castle

reviews.review:
The game is so slow and repetitive.  It feels like a game that has an hour of actual content that has been stretched out to 20x that for some reason.  Just from the start, the intro takes forever (just watch the trailer video) with no way to advance the dialog.  The enemies are all lifeless zombie bullet sponges that fire off shots at timed intervals.  They are very easy, but it takes forever to take them out (the first enemy in the game takes 20 hits to kill.)  The graphics look like they were just taken from a prefab castle game with elements like ladders stuck in there for no reason at all as the main character floats around.  The controls are terrible as well.  Rather than having a separate attack button for each spell, the game requires the player to select the spell (1-6) with one hand and then click the mouse button with another, but the mouse isn't even used for aiming - it fires in the direction the character is facing.  One of the spells is to block an enemy bullet, but in order to use it you have to take your hand off the WASD keys to press 2 to active it, click to fire, and then press 1 to go back to the default attack spell and click again all while getting your hand back to the WASD keys to move again.

The levels also take an exponentially long time to unlock.  Each has a certain crystal requirement to unlock.  Just completing the current level doesn't provide enough crystals to go to the next level.  You have to replay the past levels over and over again to collect enough to finally move on.  I had to play level 1 twice to go to level 2 and then play level 2 four times to unlock level 3 and so on.  There are only 10 levels in the game, but it will take hours to actually play that last level.

Finally, the dev has taken repetitiveness to the next level by [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/updates/887869414/1490043951]promising those who purchased the game on itchio a Steam key once it was released[/url] and then doing the complete opposite by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/727110/discussions/0/2381701715714110573/]removing the game files from itchio[/url] so customers can no longer play the game and have to re-buy it again on Steam.
